purpose: article editing / unknown read-only / known cleanup
reconstructed_design_brief: Three purple/lavender Android article-creation states: editable real WebView source with title/labels and truthful retained/pending status; readonly unknown with exact-ID full-server-version review and no retry-create; known-ID cleanup with storage-only retry and existing-article handoff. Reuses existing BookStark complex editor visual style.
